title: Claymation (templateless)
theme_prompt: CLAYMATION / stop-motion plasticine media player: hand-sculpted modelling clay with visible FINGERPRINTS, thumb-press dents, tool marks and slightly wobbly hand-made edges — like an Aardman / Wallace-and-Gromit prop. Soft matte plasticine in warm hand-mixed colours with subtle marbling where colours were kneaded together, rounded squashy forms, slightly irregular buttons like pressed clay pellets, a screen like a smoothed clay slab. Soft studio lighting with gentle clay sheen. Charming, tactile, imperfect — clearly sculpted by hand, NOT plastic, NOT glossy, NOT digital-smooth.

lighting.emissive_hint: none — matte plasticine; only the visualizer screen emits, softly
